tasks.label: LiteBox: Build All
args: cd /mnt/c/src/litebox-vscode-server && mkdir -p ~/litebox-out && cargo build --target-dir ~/litebox-out -p litebox_tool_executor -p litebox_broker -p litebox_runner_linux_userland -p litebox_test_harness && cargo rustc --target-dir ~/litebox-out/nonpie -p litebox_test_harness -- -C link-args=-no-pie

tasks.label: LiteBox: Build Docker Images
tasks.command: docker build --target litebox-vscode -t litebox-vscode -f C:\src\litebox-vscode-server\litebox_tool_executor\rootfs\Dockerfile C:\src\litebox-vscode-server && docker build --target litebox-test -t litebox-test -f C:\src\litebox-vscode-server\litebox_tool_executor\rootfs\Dockerfile C:\src\litebox-vscode-server

tasks.label: LiteBox: Start VS Code Server
tasks.command: docker rm -f litebox-vscode 2>$null; docker run --rm --name litebox-vscode -p 2222:2222 --cap-add SYS_PTRACE -v \\wsl$\Ubuntu\home\wportnoy\litebox-out\debug:/opt/litebox:ro litebox-vscode /opt/litebox/litebox_tool_executor --rootfs / --vscode-server --ssh-port 2222 --record-baseline

tasks.label: LiteBox: Start VS Code Server (Debug)
tasks.command: docker rm -f litebox-vscode 2>$null; docker run --rm --name litebox-vscode -p 2222:2222 -p 9999:9999 --cap-add SYS_PTRACE -v \\wsl$\Ubuntu\home\wportnoy\litebox-out\debug:/opt/litebox:ro litebox-vscode /opt/litebox/litebox_tool_executor --rootfs / --vscode-server --ssh-port 2222 --record-baseline --debug

tasks.label: LiteBox: Start VS Code Server (Record Baseline)
tasks.command: docker rm -f litebox-vscode 2>$null; docker run --rm --name litebox-vscode -p 2222:2222 --cap-add SYS_PTRACE -v \\wsl$\Ubuntu\home\wportnoy\litebox-out\debug:/opt/litebox:ro litebox-vscode /opt/litebox/litebox_tool_executor --rootfs / --vscode-server --ssh-port 2222 --record-baseline
